title: Autoencoder-GAN Reconstruction & Hold (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `ae_gan_hold` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Jointly trains an encoder, learned particle prior, decoder/generator, and critic on a compact representation-holding task. It verifies that adversarial updates do not erode autoencoder reconstruction fidelity (recon_mse <= 0.05) or drift off the protected hold subspace (hold <= 0.35).
failure_mode: Naive adversarial gradients overwhelm the reconstruction objective, inflating recon_mse or causing the learned prior and decoder to drift away from the encoded data manifold.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `ae_gan_hold` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
